name: Project Deep Nexus
source:
Project Deep Nexus is a science fiction visual novel centered on an overworked corporate employee at the failing artificial intelligence company, Astral World. Drowning in company debt, the protagonist agrees to beta-test the company's experimental "Deep Nexus" project—which features advanced AI clone agents based on human profiles—in exchange for full debt forgiveness.

After initiating the test from their apartment in August 2045, the protagonist loses consciousness and unexpectedly wakes up inside a simulated reality set seven years in the past, during their high school days in May 2038. The premise follows the protagonist as they navigate this simulated school environment and a multi-day summer camp trip alongside a cast of highly advanced AI versions of their former peers, blending slice-of-life school elements with the underlying corporate and technological mysteries of the simulation.
translation:
《Project Deep Nexus》是一部科幻视觉小说，主角是一名就职于濒临倒闭的人工智能公司“星界世界”、终日劳累过度的底层社畜。被公司债务压得喘不过气的他，为了换取债务全额免除，同意参与公司实验性项目“深层联结”的内部测试——该项目搭载了基于真实人类档案打造的尖端AI克隆体智能代理。

2045年8月，主角在自家公寓里启动测试后便失去了意识；岂料一觉醒来，竟发现自己置身于重现七年前——即2038年5月高中时代——的模拟现实之中。故事由此展开：主角将在昔日同窗们的高阶AI克隆体陪伴下，重温这段模拟校园日常与为期数日的夏令营之旅；作品将青春校园日常元素与潜藏在模拟世界背后的企业黑幕及科技谜团巧妙交织在了一起。
